summaryTenSecond: CivicState is built as a paid civic-letter tool, but still needs real demand and delivery validation.
adoption: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption — operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

methods: Read existing planning and master-plan files
Inspected package metadata, Prisma schema, app routes, and worker agents
Tagged repository-backed claims as evidence and external market claims as assumptions

sources.use: Existing product, architecture, revenue, risk, and financial assumptions
Core value, requirements, constraints, market verdict, and validation gates
Existing phase roadmap and completion claims
Requirement completion conflict and build reality

thesis.current: CivicState can be a small profitable civic-tech wedge if users pay for researched, citation-backed constituent letters; it is not proven as venture-scale.
thesis.honesty: Repository facts are evidence; market size, conversion, CAC, and demand are assumptions.

customerDefinition.primary: US resident with a specific civic concern who wants government action but lacks time, legal context, official routing, or drafting skill.
excluded: Enterprise advocacy teams in launch scope
Users seeking legal filings, claims, or demand letters

figures.claim: One metro at 250 paid orders/month x $15 AOV = $3,750/month gross
figures.label: assumption: bounded beta wedge

marketSizing.caution: Do not pitch TAM as top-down VC scale until real traffic, conversion, repeat usage, and channel economics exist.

financialModel.unitEconomics: Repo claims 88% to 92% gross margin and 40% net margin floor [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md]; both require production validation.
financialModel.reservePolicy: Repo requires $1,500 Mercury reserve with $2,000 warning, $1,000 critical, and $500 emergency thresholds [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md].
financialModel.validationCase: 25 orders/month x $15 AOV = $375/month gross; assumed $45/month variable cost and $200/month fixed cost yields $130/month contribution [assumption: validation scenario math].

competition.name: Resistbot
competition.position: Closest constituent-message substitute; CivicState differentiates with citation-backed research and paid delivery workflow.

competition.name: Change.org
competition.position: Competes for civic intent and public petition distribution; CivicState delivers individual letters.

competition.name: Quorum/VoterVoice
competition.position: Compete for organization advocacy budgets, not launch consumer transactions.

competition.name: Manual email and web forms
competition.position: Free incumbent substitute and strongest price-pressure risk.

killReasons: Users may not pay for a task they can do manually for free.
Official data coverage and government inbox deliverability may be harder than AI drafting.
Citation-backed civic communication may create legal-adjacent review load that breaks the one-operator model.
risksAntiPlan.antiPlan: Do not raise, hire, launch nationally, add community, or sell API access before a bounded paid beta proves conversion, delivery, citation accuracy, refunds, and review load.

assumptionLedger.assumption: Users pay $5 to $25 for done-for-you civic letters [evidence: package tiers; assumption: willingness to pay].
SEO can acquire enough intent traffic at low CAC.
assumptionLedger.validation: Search impressions, preview starts, and paid conversion by source
Bounce, spam complaint, reply, and delivered-event tracking

assumptionLedger.assumption: Citation verification prevents hallucinated legal references.
assumptionLedger.validation: Manual audit sample and all-failed citation review rate

assumptionLedger.assumption: One operator can manage legal-adjacent exceptions.
assumptionLedger.validation: Flagged queue depth and oldest item age

goToMarket.motion: One-metro beta, SEO-first, opt-in public campaign pages only after successful paid jobs.

roadmapBuildableShape: Reconcile roadmap status against actual tests and running services
Run one bounded metro beta with real payments
Verify end-to-end submission, preview, payment, delivery, and dashboard
Capture metrics needed to replace market assumptions
Confirm package economics with actual costs
Measure organic impressions from opted-in public pages
Stress-test citation, bounce, legal-adjacent, and review-backlog risks
sensitivityConstraints: Registry watchlist: personal/research asset, not near-term investible BOS unless operator confirms business intent.
Civic and political-expression data requires careful privacy and moderation handling.
Do not invent legal or regulatory conclusions; product remains constituent communication, not legal advice.

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Users may not pay even if the product works

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.hole: External API and legal claims not refreshed
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Operator must verify vendor and regulatory facts before launch
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: A core data dependency may be unavailable or more expensive

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Domain warming, seeded tests, bounce suppression, and manual contact QA
holesMitigationsResidualRisks.residualRisk: Government inboxes may filter or ignore messages

holesMitigationsResidualRisks.mitigation: Strict moderation, disclaimers, and human review
